rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an indirect derogatory reference; it does not by itself specify a sexual meaning.

example.english: That article clearly contains an innuendo about that former colleague.
example.traditional: 佢篇文章明明係影射嗰位前同事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ming4 ming4 hai6 jing2 se6 go2 wai6 cin4 tung4 si6

rows.note: Use this for a colloquial veiled dig or mocking insinuation aimed at someone.

example.english: You don't have to throw that innuendo at me.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 am3 cyun3 ngo5 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the innuendo is sexual or suggestive.

example.english: This film contains some sexual innuendo and isn't suitable for children.
example.traditional: 呢套戲有啲性暗示，唔適合細路睇。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 jau5 di1 sing3 am3 si6 m4 sik1 hap6 sai3 lou6 tai2
